description: Na₆Ca₂Nb₄Si₆(SO₁₂)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal P3c1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.49 Å) and three longer (2.78 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.64 Å) and three longer (2.65 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.62 Å) and three longer (2.72 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.22 Å) and three longer (2.27 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.16 Å) and three longer (2.37 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.90 Å) and three longer (2.27 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.96 Å) and three longer (2.13 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.96 Å) and three longer (1.99 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the fourth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.91 Å) and three longer (2.21 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra and corners with three NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-41°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.56-1.71 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra and corners with three NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-40°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.71 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-41°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.53 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Nb and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Nb and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₃CaSi trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one S atom.
